cells.docstring: Reads an audio file from disk into a NumPy floating point array and sample rate integer.

waveform.description: Audio signal data as NumPy array.

cells.docstring: Reads an uncompressed WAV file using scipy.io.wavfile.

cells.docstring: Generates a synthetic sine tone waveform given frequency, duration, and sampling rate.

frequency.description: Frequency of sine wave in Hz.

cells.docstring: Generates a periodic square wave audio signal with a specified duty cycle.

frequency.description: Frequency of square wave in Hz.

cells.code_template:
_t = np.linspace(0.0, {duration}, int({sample_rate} * {duration}), endpoint=False)
{waveform} = ({amplitude} * signal.square(2.0 * np.pi * {frequency} * _t, duty={duty})).astype(np.float32)

cells.docstring: Generates a uniform random white noise buffer of specified duration.

amplitude.description: Maximum absolute amplitude of noise signal.

cells.docstring: Creates a zeroed waveform array representing silence of given duration and channels.

num_channels.description: Number of audio channels (1 for mono, 2 for stereo).

cells.docstring: Generates a linear frequency-swept chirp waveform over a specified duration.
cells.code_template:
_t = np.linspace(0.0, {duration}, int({sample_rate} * {duration}), endpoint=False)
{waveform} = signal.chirp(_t, f0={f0}, t1={duration}, f1={f1}, method='linear').astype(np.float32)

cells.docstring: Downmixes multichannel or stereo audio to single-channel mono by averaging across channels.
Expands single-channel mono audio to 2-channel stereo by duplicating the channel.
Splits 2-channel stereo audio into separate left and right mono arrays.
Stacks discrete left and right mono channel arrays into a stereo matrix.
Normalizes waveform amplitude to peak target level (e.g. 1.0 or 0.95) to prevent clipping.
Scales waveform amplitude so that root-mean-square loudness reaches target level.
Adjusts waveform amplitude using decibel gain multiplier factor.
Applies a smooth linear ramp fade-in envelope to the start of audio waveform.
cells.code_template:
_samples = min(int({sample_rate} * {fade_duration}), len({waveform}))
_ramp = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, _samples)[:, None] if {waveform}.ndim > 1 else np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, _samples)
{faded_waveform} = {waveform}.copy()
{faded_waveform}[:_samples] = {faded_waveform}[:_samples] * _ramp

cells.docstring: Applies a smooth linear decay fade-out envelope to the tail of audio waveform.
cells.code_template:
_samples = min(int({sample_rate} * {fade_duration}), len({waveform}))
_ramp = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, _samples)[:, None] if {waveform}.ndim > 1 else np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, _samples)
{faded_waveform} = {waveform}.copy()
{faded_waveform}[-_samples:] = {faded_waveform}[-_samples:] * _ramp

cells.docstring: Clamps waveform sample amplitudes within symmetric hard threshold limits.
Extracts temporal subsegment from waveform between start_sec and end_sec timestamps.

sliced_waveform.description: Segment sliced between start_sec and end_sec.

cells.docstring: Trims leading and trailing audio samples whose absolute amplitude remains below threshold.

trimmed_waveform.description: Waveform with leading and trailing silence stripped.

cells.docstring: Concatenates two audio waveforms sequentially along the time dimension.
Reverses audio waveform samples temporally for backwards playback.
Pads start and end of audio signal with specified durations of silence.

pad_start_sec.description: Duration of leading silence padding in seconds.

pad_end_sec.description: Duration of trailing silence padding in seconds.

padded_waveform.description: Waveform padded with silence at start and end.

cells.code_template:
_n_start = int({pad_start_sec} * {sample_rate})
_n_end = int({pad_end_sec} * {sample_rate})
_pad_width = ((_n_start, _n_end), (0, 0)) if {waveform}.ndim > 1 else ((_n_start, _n_end),)
{padded_waveform} = np.pad({waveform}, _pad_width, mode='constant')

cells.docstring: Resamples audio signal to target sampling rate using Fourier method via scipy.signal.resample.
cells.code_template:
_target_num = int(round(len({waveform}) * float({target_sr}) / float({orig_sr})))
{resampled_waveform} = signal.resample({waveform}, _target_num, axis=0).astype({waveform}.dtype)
{new_sr} = int({target_sr})

cells.docstring: Applies a single-tap delay echo reflection with exponential decay.

echo_waveform.description: Audio waveform with added echo delay.

cells.code_template:
_delay_samples = int({delay_sec} * {sample_rate})
_pad_shape = (_delay_samples, {waveform}.shape[1]) if {waveform}.ndim > 1 else (_delay_samples,)
_delayed = np.concatenate([np.zeros(_pad_shape, dtype={waveform}.dtype), {waveform}], axis=0)
_original = np.concatenate([{waveform}, np.zeros(_pad_shape, dtype={waveform}.dtype)], axis=0)
{echo_waveform} = _original + {decay} * _delayed

zxx.description: STFT of waveform as complex array.

cells.docstring: Computes Inverse Short-Time Fourier Transform (ISTFT) matrix back to time domain signal.
Computes magnitude/power spectrogram matrix via scipy.signal.spectrogram.
Maps linear magnitude spectrogram into perceptual Mel-scale frequency filterbanks.
cells.code_template:
_n_freqs = {spectrogram}.shape[0]
_m_pts = np.linspace(0.0, 2595.0 * np.log10(1.0 + ({sample_rate} / 2.0) / 700.0), {n_mels} + 2)
_hz_pts = 700.0 * (10.0 ** (_m_pts / 2595.0) - 1.0)
_bins = np.clip(np.floor((_n_freqs - 1) * 2 * _hz_pts / {sample_rate}).astype(int), 0, _n_freqs - 1)
_fb = np.zeros(({n_mels}, _n_freqs), dtype=np.float32)
for _i in range(1, {n_mels} + 1):
    if _bins[_i] > _bins[_i - 1]:
        _fb[_i - 1, _bins[_i - 1]:_bins[_i]] = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, _bins[_i] - _bins[_i - 1], endpoint=False)
    if _bins[_i + 1] > _bins[_i]:
        _fb[_i - 1, _bins[_i]:_bins[_i + 1]] = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, _bins[_i + 1] - _bins[_i], endpoint=False)
{mel_spectrogram} = np.dot(_fb, {spectrogram})

cells.docstring: Converts power/magnitude spectrogram into decibel scale (10 * log10(S / ref)).

ref_value.description: Reference power value for decibel ratio.

cells.docstring: Applies a pre-emphasis filter to boost high frequency components y[t] = x[t] - alpha * x[t-1].
Applies a Butterworth lowpass filter to remove frequencies above cutoff.
cells.code_template:
_sos = signal.butter({order}, {cutoff_freq}, btype='lowpass', fs={sample_rate}, output='sos')
{filtered_waveform} = signal.sosfilt(_sos, {waveform}, axis=0)

cells.docstring: Applies a Butterworth highpass filter to remove low frequency rumble below cutoff.
cells.code_template:
_sos = signal.butter({order}, {cutoff_freq}, btype='highpass', fs={sample_rate}, output='sos')
{filtered_waveform} = signal.sosfilt(_sos, {waveform}, axis=0)

cells.docstring: Applies a Butterworth bandpass filter passing frequencies between lowcut and highcut.
cells.code_template:
_sos = signal.butter({order}, [{lowcut}, {highcut}], btype='bandpass', fs={sample_rate}, output='sos')
{filtered_waveform} = signal.sosfilt(_sos, {waveform}, axis=0)

cells.docstring: Renders and exports spectrogram matrix visualization to an image file.

image_path.description: File path for spectrogram plot image (.png, .jpg).

sample_rate.description: Sampling frequency in Hz for axis frequency mapping.

out_image_path.description: Path to the saved spectrogram visualization.

cells.code_template:
_extent = [0, {spectrogram}.shape[1], 0, float({sample_rate}) / 2.0]
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
_im = _ax.imshow({spectrogram}, origin='lower', aspect='auto', cmap='magma', extent=_extent)
_ax.set_title('Spectrogram')
_ax.set_xlabel('Time Frame')
_ax.set_ylabel('Frequency (Hz)')
_fig.colorbar(_im, ax=_ax)
_fig.tight_layout()
_fig.savefig({image_path}, dpi=150)
plt.close(_fig)
{out_image_path} = {image_path}

cells.docstring: Plots amplitude envelope of audio waveform and saves image to disk.

sample_rate.description: Sampling rate in Hz for time-axis scaling.

out_image_path.description: Path to the saved waveform plot.

cells.code_template:
_fig, _ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3))
_time_axis = np.linspace(0.0, len({waveform}) / float({sample_rate}), len({waveform}), endpoint=False)
_ax.plot(_time_axis, {waveform}, linewidth=0.5)
_ax.set_title('Waveform Envelope')
_ax.set_xlabel('Time (s)')
_ax.set_ylabel('Amplitude')
_fig.tight_layout()
_fig.savefig({image_path}, dpi=150)
plt.close(_fig)
{out_image_path} = {image_path}
